Privacy Authentication Integrity Non-Repudiation

These are aspects of data security that are utilized to communicate in a safe/secure fashion.

Privacy = Encryption, keeping the data obfuscated from anyone other than the intended recipient(s)

Authentication = Assurance that the sender of said encrypted data is who they say they are

Integrity = Verification that the original data sent is exactly what it is supposed to be upon receipt

Non-Repudiation = The receiver of the encrypted data can verify that it came from intended sender
